sources.ports:
Module port assignments.
shell listens on 5180.
sovereign listens on 5175.
debate listens on 8700.
tokencenter listens on 8765.
distillery listens on 5184.
sources.state:
State layout.
Runtime state lives outside the install root under %LOCALAPPDATA%\SovereignWorkspace.
Each module has its own directory named for its module id.
The environment variable SOVEREIGN_WORKSPACE_STATE overrides the location.
sources.backup:
Backup procedure.
Stop the shell and every module before taking a backup; the snapshot contract is offline.
backup_state.ps1 writes one archive, a .sha256 sidecar and an inventory sidecar.
restore_state.ps1 verifies the sidecar before writing anything.
A restore over live state requires -Force and moves the existing state aside.
sources.upgrade:
Upgrade procedure.
upgrade.ps1 stages its controller outside the installation before moving anything.
Exit code 2 means it refused before any change was made.
Exit code 4 means it failed and rolled back to the previous installation.
Exit code 5 means the rollback itself did not complete.
sources.limits:
Support limits.
The product is Windows-only.
Python 3.12 runs the shell; Python 3.14 runs the Debate module.
Node 24 is required for the SOW desktop app.
sources.ports_conflicting:
Deployment note, revision B.
sovereign listens on 5199 in this deployment.
This note supersedes earlier port documentation for sovereign only.
sources.state_conflicting:
Deployment note, revision C.
In this deployment runtime state is kept under D:\SovereignState instead.
This note disagrees with the standard state layout document.
sources.retention:
Retention policy.
Module logs are capped at 5 MiB each and rotated once.
Backups are never deleted automatically.
The previous installation is retained after an upgrade until removed by hand.
sources.quiescence:
Quiescence rules.
backup_state.ps1 opens each file denying other writers to prove nothing is being written.
If any file is held open the backup refuses and names the files.
-AllowNonQuiescent captures anyway and labels the archive as not a consistent snapshot.
